name: Refer a Friend for WooCommerce to Launch Your Customer Referral Program – EchoRewards Referral Plugin
author: WPPOOL

sections.description:
Website | Documentation | Tutorials | Live Demo

Create your customer referral program with the ideal refer a friend plugin for WordPress. With EchoRewards, automate customer rewards and easily add a refer a friend program to your WooCommerce store. Running a customer referral campaign is no longer a hassle!

Let’s grow, connect, and thrive together!

  • 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community
  • 🌐 Follow Us on X (Twitter)
  • 🎥 Subscribe on YouTube
  • 👍 Like Our Facebook Page

🎉 Unlock the Magic of Mutual Discounts 🎉

With EchoRewards, your customers can easily share exclusive coupons with their friends and family. When someone redeems a coupon, not only do they receive a special discount, but the person who shared it also gets rewarded. It’s a win-win for everyone involved! 😍

Welcome to the new and better way of sharing incentives among your customers. Echo Rewards organically turns your customers into affiliates and increases customer acquisition instantly. 🚀

EchoRewards Refer a Friend Plugin Helps you Achieve:

  • Increased Customer Acquisition: People are more likely to try a new product or service when recommended by someone they trust. This WooCommerce coupon plugin turns your customer base into a sales force.
  • Reduced Marketing Costs: Customer-to-customer referrals can reduce the cost of acquiring new customers, as compared to traditional advertising channels.
  • Enhanced Customer Loyalty: Offering referral rewards shows appreciation, potentially increasing customer retention.
  • Trackable Marketing: You can track which customers provide the most referrals and which channels are most effective.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

😃 EchoRewards Free Features

  • 👥 Unlimited Referral Coupons: Every customer gets their unique referral coupon to share with friends, family, and social networks. Once the coupon is used, the referrer and the friend receive a discount, fostering community and excitement.

  • 🔗 Referral Links: Each customer receives a unique referral link to share across their network. When someone uses this link to reach the cart page, the discount is automatically applied, no hassle of input the referral code —no codes, no hassle!

  • 💳 Customize Discount Type: Customize your referral incentives from percentage discounts to fixed amounts.

  • 👥 Referrer Status Customization: Easily decide on the customers eligible for the referral program. If you enable this feature, the referrer will require at least one order in your store before he can refer others.

  • 🔒 Discount Capping: Maintain control over your discounts with the option to set a discount capping, ensuring that your referral program remains within your budget.

  • 🔍 Include/Exclude Products & Categories: Customize your referral program by selecting specific products or categories to be included or excluded.

  • 💰 Set Minimum Purchase Amount: Set the minimum amount of purchase to avail a referral coupon benefit.

  • 🧑‍💻 Shortcode Support: Place the Echo Rewards components (referral card, email invitation card, reward coupon table, and invitation tracking table) anywhere on your website with a shortcode. It doesn’t get easier than this!

  • 📊 Advanced Reporting & Analytics: Get 7 days of FREE referral program analytics and discover actionable insights. Understand your program’s effectiveness, identify top referrers, and make data-driven decisions. Don’t miss out!”

  • 💰 Discount Amount Customization: Customize the discount amount that a referrer or referee gets from a successful referral.

  • 🛒 Referral Program Tab on WooCommerce: Raise awareness about your referral program by enabling the Referral Program Tab on WooCommerce. Your customers can learn about your program and also sign up to avail their benefits.

  • 📩 Email Notifications: Referrers receive email notifications containing reward coupons when a friend uses a referral coupon and completes an order.

  • 🔍 Invitation Tracking: Referrers can easily track the progress of their shared coupon from their “My Account” page.

  • 📱 Social Sharing: With social sharing users can effortlessly share referral coupons through Facebook , X (Twitter) and What’s app enhancing program visibility.

  • 📨 Email Invitation: Referrers can share their referral code through email, ensuring a swift way of sharing benefits among friends.

  • 📊 Intuitive Admin Dashboard: Get an intuitive dashboard to customize your referral program settings including referral program status, referral discount amount, referee discount amount, etc.

  • 💻 Multisite Supported: EchoReward’s multisite compatibility makes sure that the plugin features can be accessed by every website on the multisite network.

  • 📋Referrer Insights: You can view referrer name and email directly on the order details page for orders using referral coupons, enabling better tracking and insights into referral-driven sales.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

👑 EchoRewards Pro Features

  • 💳 Customize Reward Points: Customize your incentives with Rewards Points. Offer personalized rewards to motivate referrals and increase engagement.

  • 🎈 Floating Referral Widget: This is a game change for your business! You can easily notify your site, visitors, about your referral program through a floating widget which will attract more customers.

  • 🔁Recurring Coupons: Recurring referral coupons and recurring reward coupons can be used in WooCommerce Subscription products. These coupons will be automatically applied to subscription renewal payments. Reward customers with recurring discounts for every successful referral, encouraging long-term retention and growth through subscription-based rewards.

  • 🛠️ Gutenberg Block & Elementor Referral Widget: Unleash the full potential of your referral program with your preferred page builder. Whether you are using the default block editor (Gutenberg) or Elementor, you can place the referral card, email invitation card, reward coupon table, and invitation tracking table anywhere on your website with our Gutenberg blocks and Elementor widgets.

  • 🌪️ Funnel Integration: EchoReward is deeply integrated with FunnelKit, WPFunnels and most funnel plugins in the market that support Gutenberg and Elementor widgets. Integrate the referral program at any step of the funnel and improve the success of your program instantly.

  • 🏷️ Referral Coupon Prefix: Add a unique coupon prefix to give your referral program a more personalized feel.

  • 🛍️ Restrict Coupons for Specific Products: Choose the products where you can redeem the coupons.

  • 📧 Customize Rewards Email: You can customize the reward email as you wish from the plugin settings (subject, heading, and description).

  • 🌐 Extended Social Sharing Options: Allow customers to effortlessly spread the word across 14 social network channels.

  • 🧑‍💻 Shortcode Support: Place the Rewards Points table on your website with a single shortcode. It doesn’t get easier than this!

  • 📊 Advanced Reporting & Analytics: Monitor referral statistics including the most active referrer, new customer acquisition, and total generated revenue from the referral program. Take proactive decisions based on your program’s performance and enhance your future marketing efforts.

  • 🔏 Coupon Privacy: Decide whether only logged-in or all customers will be allowed to apply referral coupon during purchase.

  • ⌛ Reward Coupon Validity: Set a validity for how long the reward coupon will be valid.

  • 🔒 Referral Access Control: Boost referral program integrity by restricting referral coupon and link usage to logged-in customers. Protect against misuse while enhancing trust and ensuring fair rewards for genuine referrals

  • 📧 Dynamic Email Tags: Personalize referral emails effortlessly with dynamic tags. Automatically replace placeholders like Referrer Name and Referral Discount with actual values to create tailored, professional communications. Simplify customization and enhance engagement!

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

⚡ Floating Referral Widget to Promote Your Referral Program

Enhance your referral program’s visibility with the built-in Floating Referral Widget, a dynamic tool that effortlessly promotes your referral program to visitors. This eye-catching widget remains visible as users navigate your site, ensuring maximum exposure and engagement. By seamlessly integrating into the user experience, the Floating Referral Widget captivates attention and drives participation, ultimately boosting referral program awareness and conversions. 🚀

So, what are you waiting for? Enhance your WooCommerce store, boost customer engagement, and watch your sales soar with EchoReward. Let’s create a more rewarding shopping experience for your customers together!

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get Premium | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

🔥 More Awesome Plugins

If you like EchoReward, then consider checking out our other awesome projects:

  • 🔄 FlexStock – Stock Sync with Google Sheet for WooCommerce – Auto-sync WooCommerce products from Google Sheets. Flex Stock is an easy, powerful, and simple inventory management system to handle your WooCommerce products.

  • 🛒 FlexOrder – Order Sync with Google Sheet for WooCommerce – Manage WooCommerce orders from Google Sheets. WooCommerce order sync, e-commerce order management, and sales order management with Google Sheets by our Flex Order.

  • 🟢 FlexTable – Sheets To WP Table Live Sync – Google Sheets allows you to input data on your Google sheet and show the same data on WordPress as a table effortlessly. Try Flex Table now!

  • 📽️ Webinar & Video Conference with Jitsi Meet – Experience the best WordPress video conference plugin and live video chat solution. Get shortcode support with WooCommerce and BuddyPress integration.

  • 📝 FormyChat – Send contact form leads to WhatsApp chat. This WhatsApp notification plugin makes it easy to manage contact forms. Quick, easy and no coding required.

Privacy Policy

EchoReward uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to WordPress Dashboard>Plugins>Add New. Search “Echo Rewards” and activate the plugin.
  2. Make sure that WooCommerce is installed and activated on your site.
  3. Access the plugin settings from Marketing>EchoReward.
  4. Update your referral and reward settings and begin your referral program journey!

Learn more about how Echo Reward works through our overview video.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know any programming language for using this plugin?

No coding knowledge is required for using this plugin.

How do I create a refer a friend program in WooCommerce?

The easiest way to create a refer a friend referral program in WooCommerce is through the EchoReward plugin. Install and activate the plugin, customize the referral settings and boost your sales.

Where do I contact for support?

Please use the official WordPress support forum to report your issues.
